verso-plugin-vpn.description: Session grants for Verso's VPN page: OpenVPN's own config; the network and firewall configs, where an imported tunnel gets a network on its device and joins a zone; this plugin's own root read of what the tunnels are doing (ADR-027); the helper's listing of the profiles (folded by this plugin's root half, keys left at root); and staging a profile through the helper's file journal. The shell holds the operator's session and performs these on the plugin's behalf (ADR-007), so this file is what makes the manifest's declared acl grantable at rpcd — the plugin itself holds no session and no privilege.
